title: Clustered Local Projections for Short and Ultra-Short Time Series -- A Hierarchical Bayesian Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.04631v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating the dynamic effects of economic shocks in short and very short samples is impeded by a lack of degrees of freedom. We offer a solution based on a Bayesian hierarchical framework for estimating local projection (LP) impulse response functions across a panel of related time series. The framework explicitly accommodates unbalanced panels in which some series are substantially shorter than others, allowing the short series to borrow information from longer ones at horizons where the short series carry little or no own data. Since series might exhibit heterogeneous dynamics, we develop a sparse finite mixture pool that clusters units by similarity of their impulse response profiles. We show in simulations that our approach substantially improves LP estimation accuracy relative to the standard approach if the time series are short while producing similar LPs for longer time series. translated_title: 短与超短时间序列的聚类局部投影——一种分层贝叶斯框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.04631v3 公告类型：替换版 摘要：在短样本和极短样本中估计经济冲击的动态效应，受到自由度不足的阻碍。我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯分层框架的解决方案，用于在相关时间序列面板中估计局部投影（LP）脉冲响应函数。该框架明确适应了不平衡面板，其中一些序列比其他序列短得多，使得短序列能够在长序列携带较少或没有自身数据的预测期，从较长序列中借用信息。由于序列可能表现出异质性动态，我们开发了一种稀疏有限混合池，根据脉冲响应轮廓的相似性对单元进行聚类。模拟结果表明，与标准方法相比，我们的方法在时间序列较短时显著提高了LP估计精度，同时对于较长的时间序列产生相似的LP结果。使用美国价格数据集（辅以调查）进行了验证。
tldr: 本文提出一种分层贝叶斯聚类局部投影框架，使短时间序列能从相关长序列中借用信息，并通过稀疏混合池聚类异质动态，显著提升短样本下的脉冲响应估计精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical Bayesian clustered local projection framework that enables short time series to borrow information from longer related ones, and uses a sparse finite mixture pool to cluster heterogeneous dynamics, significantly improving impulse response estimation accuracy in short samples.
